parameters.query: SELECT ultimo_update_id FROM telegram_offset WHERE id = 1;

UPDATE telegram_offset SET ultimo_update_id = GREATEST(ultimo_update_id, $1::bigint), actualizado_en = now()
WHERE id = 1 RETURNING ultimo_update_id;

WITH
est AS (
  SELECT id, nombre FROM estaciones WHERE activo AND id = $3::int
),
alta AS (
  INSERT INTO suscriptores_telegram (chat_id, estacion_id)
  SELECT $1::bigint, id FROM est WHERE $2 = '/suscribir'
  ON CONFLICT (chat_id, estacion_id) DO UPDATE SET activo = true
  RETURNING estacion_id
),
baja AS (
  UPDATE suscriptores_telegram SET activo = false
  WHERE $2 = '/baja' AND chat_id = $1::bigint AND estacion_id = $3::int AND activo
  RETURNING estacion_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM alta) AS altas,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM baja) AS bajas,
  (SELECT nombre FROM est) AS estacion,
  (SELECT string_agg(id::text || ' · ' || nombre, E'\n' ORDER BY nombre) FROM estaciones WHERE activo) AS lista;
